mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invoice ( invoice_number, booking_id, total_amount_value, discount_type, discount_rate, discounted_amount_value, payment_status, due_date ) VALUES ( #{invoiceNumber}, #{bookingId}, #{totalAmountValue}, #{discountType}, #{discountRate}, #{discountedAmountValue}, #{paymentStatus}, #{dueDate} )
mapper.update: UPDATE invoice SET payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE invoice_number = #{invoiceNumber}
mapper.select: SELECT id, invoice_number, booking_id, total_amount_value, discount_type, discount_rate, discounted_amount_value, payment_status, due_date, created_at, updated_at FROM invoice WHERE invoice_number = #{invoiceNumber}

SELECT id, invoice_number, booking_id, total_amount_value, discount_type, discount_rate, discounted_amount_value, payment_status, due_date, created_at, updated_at FROM invoice WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId}

SELECT id, invoice_number, booking_id, total_amount_value, discount_type, discount_rate, discounted_amount_value, payment_status, due_date, created_at, updated_at FROM invoice ORDER BY created_at DESC
